artifact_reasoning: Several artifacts detract from realism. 1) The doll's skin has a waxy, plastic-like texture with fused joint details (shoulders/hips), typical of AI generation. 2) The diaper tabs lack crisp edges and appear partially melted into the side panels. 3) The lighting is overly dark/low-contrast (noted by perceptual auditor), reducing clarity. 4) The changing pad has slight perspective warping. These issues prevent a higher artifact score, placing it below the 'mid' reference quality.
